answer_1.quote: Text style transfer (TST) aims to generate a text exhibiting a desired style based on the source text (e.g., negative → positive), while endeavoring to faithfully preserve the semantic content.

answer_2.quote: Following previous studies of , we employ both automatic and human evaluations.

answer_4.quote: three Chinese native speakers are assigned the task of scoring for style polarity (Sty), content preservation (Con), and fluency (Flu), using a scale of 1 (very bad) to 3 (very good).
